captions.detailed: A miniature stone bell tower featuring a square, multi-tiered masonry column base with horizontal ridges. At the top belfry level, a bronze-colored bell is suspended from a dark wooden headstock. The tower is capped with a dark, pyarmid-shaped roof, and a separate black pulley wheel guide is attached to the side near the base. The bell rotates on a revolute joint, while the base pulley wheel rotates independently on a continuous joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a square masonry bell tower with a pyramid roof. It should include a swinging bronze bell mounted on a revolute headstock joint in the upper belfry, and an independent rope-guide pulley wheel mounted near the base on a continuous joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main tower body as a series of stacked box primitives with offset horizontal ridges, capped by a pyramid-shaped roof. Create the belfry opening by positioning corner pillars. Model the bell using a revolved profile or a series of concentric cylinders and cones, and mount it on a horizontal axle. Create the pulley wheel guide at the base using a small cylinder and brackets, and define two independent joints: a revolute joint for the bell axle and a continuous joint for the pulley wheel.
